list.title: Gastown AI Agents: From 5 to 36 PRs in Hours
list.description: A first-hand look at using Gastown, parallel polecat workers, and the Beads issue tracker across several software modules. PR counts vary in size and scope, so they’re not a measure of code quality—but this workflow made a striking difference in one developer’s experience.
